title: Fix PolicyYamlEditor.tsx — import conflicts with local countRulesFromYaml
description:
**File:** `dashboard/src/components/policy/PolicyYamlEditor.tsx`

**Problem:** Line 11 imports `countRulesFromYaml` from `../../lib/policy-yaml`, but lines 264-273 define a local function with the same name. TypeScript error TS2440: import declaration conflicts with local declaration.

**Root cause:** The function was originally local, then extracted to `lib/policy-yaml.ts`, but the local copy wasn't removed.

**Fix:** Remove the local function definition (lines 260-273). The imported version from `lib/policy-yaml` is identical — both parse YAML via `validatePolicyYaml()` and count the `rules` array. The import on line 11 is used at line 135.
definitionOfDone: TypeScript error TS2440 in PolicyYamlEditor.tsx is resolved
Rule count still displays correctly in the editor

implementationPlan.description: Bug already fixed: the duplicate local countRulesFromYaml function has been removed from PolicyYamlEditor.tsx. The file now only uses the import from lib/policy-yaml.ts (line 11). No changes needed — verify with tsc --noEmit.
